evidence_items.text: No brain-fog-specific human grounding study exists in the located evidence.

evidence_items.text: Kim T et al. 2024 (PMID 38926837) is an ordinary barefoot-versus-sneaker playground exercise and cognition study; conductivity, electrical Earth connection and brain fog were not tested. It receives no H identifier and is distinct from H34 (Kim JS et al. 2024).
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Blocks the most likely misattribution in this case: two 2024 barefoot studies by authors named Kim, only one of which is eligible, and neither of which addresses brain fog.

evidence_items.text: Documented proposition-specific search across PubMed (0 found/0 screened), Europe PMC title/abstract (0/0) and full text (0/0) and OpenAlex (40 deduplicated) with grounding, earthing, barefoot, soil-contact and Earth-contact terminology to the 22 August 2026 cut-off: class A, negative search state confirmed.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Establishes the breadth of the documented basis for the negative statement.

evidence_items.text: Brain fog and cognitive fog were never operationalised as endpoints; no validated cognition or cognitive-fatigue measure appears in the substrate.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Even a well-designed study could not have supported the claim without a defined measure.

scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.

unresolved_questions: An operational brain-fog definition with validated cognition or fatigue endpoints has never been studied. The absence is a bounded retrieval finding within the documented routes and terminology, not proof that no relevant study exists.

verdict.verdict_summary: No grounding or Earth-contact study operationalising brain fog or cognitive fog was located; the structured routes returned zero records in PubMed and Europe PMC. The one superficially similar record, an ordinary playground barefoot exercise and cognition study, tested neither conductivity nor brain fog and is screening-ineligible.
